metric_notes.pairing: All 72 cells within a horizon share parameter worlds and the same CRNBlock instance; every delta is paired path by path.
metric_notes.spread_definition: spread_of_medians_eur is max(median) - min(median) across cells, as PROJECT_META specifies. paired_median_delta_eur is the median of the paired per-path differences between the extreme cells, which additionally carries a P_model.

ter_treatment.note: config/costs.json holds unsourced placeholders (data_status PLACEHOLDER_NOT_SOURCED). The absolute TER level is not a cost estimate. The sweep measures how much a TER DIFFERENCE of a given size moves the outcome, which is what the 0.124 pp G1 gate must be compared against.
